farm_steps: Use a fresh wallet that holds only the funds you plan to farm, and keep its seed phrase offline; fund it from an exchange withdrawal, not from a wallet that touches your main accounts. Cost: under $3 of gas for the first transaction. Time: 5 minutes.

Hold the position for at least 30 days so the activity lands in more than one monthly snapshot; at 543 days old, Steakhouse Financial rewards sustained use over a single deposit. Cost: the $150 stays in the position. Time: 30 days.

Steakhouse Financial also runs on Ethereum: repeating the core action there doubles the addresses that can be counted, at about twice the gas. Cost: about $10 of gas extra. Time: 15 minutes.

Check whether Steakhouse Financial runs an official points or quest program and register the wallet there; if it publishes none, watch its announcements channel instead of third-party claim pages. Cost: no fee to check, and never pay to claim. Time: 10 minutes.

Before you withdraw, claim only from the link Steakhouse Financial's own site publishes, write the wallet, the dates and every transaction in a farm log, and unwind the week any token goes live. Cost: nothing but the log. Time: 15 minutes.

Size the position below 0.5% of the pool or market you enter (GoonFi's TVL is $5,227,088), so your exit never moves the price you get. Cost: no extra cost, a sizing rule. Time: 2 minutes to check.

Check whether GoonFi runs an official points or quest program and register the wallet there; if it publishes none, watch its announcements channel instead of third-party claim pages. Cost: no fee to check, and never pay to claim. Time: 10 minutes.

Before you withdraw, claim only from the link GoonFi's own site publishes, write the wallet, the dates and every transaction in a farm log, and unwind the week any token goes live. Cost: nothing but the log. Time: 15 minutes.
